_comment: AB-529 parallel run, reconciliation and rollback plan. Checked by `make migration` (tools/migration/parallel_run.py check). The cycle dates, the rollback window and every sign-off are agreed outside the code and recorded here; until then they are null/pending and the gate fails. No step is ever executed from this branch.

cycle.description: One full monthly billing cycle (AB-529 acceptance): every business day from the first business day after cycle start through the cycle end, including the 1st-of-month actuarial exposure run.

rehearsals.evidence: pas-batch MigrationJobsIT.rollbackRehearsalPointsBackAtTheLegacyDatabaseWithinTheWindow: cutover, writes on PostgreSQL, migrationReverseSync, zero reconciliation differences, DB2 POLICY_SEQ above PostgreSQL, system of record back to DB2

rehearsals.environment: Pre-production with DB2 for z/OS and the production-sized book

outputs.legacy: DSNTIAUL unload of ACMEINS.PREMIUMS after PAS0050, ordered by key

runbook.step: Bulk load: pas-batch migrationBulkLoad into an empty PostgreSQL ACMEINS; reconciliation MATCH
Start change sync: migrationDeltaSync on schedule (or the licensed CDC product, FU-529-1); daily migrationReconciliation
Parallel run: Java premium batch and extracts on the parallel database every business day; parallel_run.py compare; daily triage
Gate: parallel_run.py gate passes for one full cycle, reconciliation MATCH every day, pre-production rollback rehearsal inside the window, every sign-off approved
Cutover: DB2 ACMEINS writes stopped, final migrationDeltaSync, reconciliation MATCH, migrationSystemOfRecord system=PG, applications pointed at PostgreSQL
Rollback (inside the window): PostgreSQL writes stopped, migrationReverseSync confirmRollback=YES, applications pointed back at DB2

sign_offs.role: Mainframe team (captured outputs, PREMIUMS unload, read access to ACMEINS, DB2 sequence restart)
DBA (migration service accounts, CDC/delta load on DB2, pre-production rollback rehearsal)
Product owner (billing cycle, triage decisions, zero unexplained differences)
Security / data governance (PII copied to PostgreSQL, acmeins_shadow retention)
Claims and Actuarial consumers (parallel extract files)
ARB (DS-02 shadow schema, MSG-02 CDC product)
